memoryBuilder.verseText: The LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

sequence.prompt: What happened when God chose a new king? Put it in order.

items.label: Samuel came to find a new king
God said: I look at the heart
David the shepherd boy was chosen

matches.prompt: Match each to what they looked at.

application.question: God chose David because of his heart. What do YOU want your heart to be like?
application.followUp: God sees your heart right now — and He loves what He made in you. Ask Him to help your heart grow more and more like David's.
